Nina V: Heads-up  drafting outbound for customers whose onboarding activation stalled due to today's embeddings ingestion latency spike. Need concise update, retry instructions, and credit wording. Draft below.

Nina V: ```Subject: Update: embeddings ingestion delay affecting onboarding activations

Hi <CustomerContact>,

Status: Mitigated  embeddings ingestion latency restored.

What happened: between 07:40 and 08:55 UTC we saw elevated latency and intermittent timeouts in the embeddings ingestion pipeline caused by a malformed batch backpressure loop after a deploy. This primarily affected customers doing initial bulk embeddings or large reindex jobs, delaying activation and scoring steps.

Impact: you may have observed stalled activations, delayed search/semantic ranking for newly ingested content, or timeout errors during large imports. Existing embeddings used for live inference were not retroactively degraded.

What we did: rolled back the deploy, killed the stuck workers, and replayed queued ingestion batches; normal ingestion throughput returned by 08:55 UTC.

What you can do: if you see failed jobs, please retry the import from the same job ID. For customers who prefer us to replay jobs on your behalf, reply with the job ID and an OK to re-run; our target window for managed replays is 24-72 hours and for very large imports we'll coordinate a custom schedule.

Compensation: tenants with confirmed activation delays may be eligible for a one-time onboarding credit up to the equivalent of one week of ingestion usage. Enterprise accounts: account teams will follow up with tailored remediation. (Legal review pending.)

Resources: status.redwood.ai (incident #2026-EMB-INGEST), replay console: https://console.redwood.ai/tenants/<tenant-id>/replays, office hours today 15:00 UTC for troubleshooting.

We're sorry for the interruption
Best,
CS Ops
```
